Compact Build.name: Compact Build
Compact Build.description:
💪 Build: Compact Build
Everything pulled tight into a moderate frame — no wasted space, with proportions that suggest efficiency over height or bulk.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Compact Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Compact frame — everything drawn tight and efficient, no wasted space. Proportional, balanced, and dense without reading as large. Female: shoulders narrow and level with the hips, short slim neck, small soft jaw, a small chest line above a short waist. Male: shoulders squared close to the hips, short thick neck, blunt jaw, a flat chest on a short straight torso. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure drawn tight.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
